summary_en: Toyo Drilube issued a correction to its September 11, 2026 disclosure on capital cost and share price-conscious management initiatives. The revision addressed an omission in the IR activity enhancement section on page 5 of the materials.
title_en: Correction: Regarding Partial Revision of "Initiatives toward Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price (Update)"
translation_en_brief:
On September 14, 2026, Toyo Drilube Co., Ltd. announced a correction to its capital cost and share price-conscious management initiatives disclosed on September 11, 2026. The correction addressed an omission in the materials. Specifically, page 5 of the disclosure materials, which detailed "Specific Initiatives: Enhancement of IR Activities" under section 2-3, contained incomplete information that required revision and clarification.

The company stated that portions of the original disclosure were missing and needed to be corrected. While the disclosure does not provide details of the specific content added or changed, the corrected materials were reissued to ensure accurate communication of the company's capital cost and share price management strategy to investors.
